Seven typed structural predicates covering the contract correction classes: a tax actor, proceeding or remedy relation makes a concise phrase a complete tax subject; a revenue issuance that changes a tax or withholding rate is a tax relation without an issuance identifier; a primary label, print, caption or display action controls its own target; an ordinary or program artefact governs its own target but yields to any governed tax predicate including Filipino and negation-framed forms; and antecedent-resolved, nominalised-transaction and subordinate-code-clause targets all build treatment relations.
iterations.affectedFamilies: tax_procedure_with_domain_attachment, primary_tax_over_subordinate_code, label_or_display_action_controls, ordinary_domain_controls, antecedent_resolved_target, governed_predicate_over_concrete_target

iterations.hypothesis: A governed tax predicate stated anywhere in the query stops the label and contentless guards from displacing a real tax question, but the styling/program-artefact guard yields only when the artefact is the OBJECT of a commercial tax transaction, since a tax-shaped word that names or defines an artefact is a homograph. A named statute in a treatment or effect frame, a multi-clause query that explicitly flags its principal tax question, and a bare tax topic carrying a claim, prescription or remedy relation are all governed subject matter.
iterations.affectedFamilies: primary_tax_vs_subordinate_label, primary_tax_vs_subordinate_code, legal_title_vs_internal_label, multiclause_reversal, bare_tax_topic, taxable_output_vs_console_output

iterations.hypothesis: The contentless guard yields to a statute-in-effect frame, which names its own subject. CWT joins the narrow canonical acronym set as creditable withholding tax with no material competing ordinary sense, still excluding DST and VAT. The homograph veto is defeated only by a subordinate code or tag clause under a governed tax predicate, not by any tax predicate: a program artefact governing the target keeps the veto.

Two defects in the labelBinding expression. The subordinate-clause alternation omitted the prepositions under and with, so a code clause introduced that way was not recognised as subordinate. More seriously, operator precedence bound the expression as (negation && firstAlternative) || rest, so the subordinate-clause negation only guarded the first alternative and the remaining alternatives could still set label binding. The alternation is now parenthesised as a whole.
